text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The October breeze blows through France.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Racers from around the world have
gathered here at this most
prestigious of
turf races.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will the one to snag the crown be the hero
of Japan, El Condor Pasa?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Or will it be France's pride and joy,
Montjeu?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe begins...
now!
